pinned_inputs_and_reproduction.objdump_argv: Both recorded invocations use the pinned arc-elf32-objdump with -D -b binary -m arc:em -EL and --adjust-vma 0x300000 / 0x300400 on the corresponding materialized package slices.

details: The new source script makes command construction and textual parsing reproducible; it recognizes candidate control mnemonics by prefix and extracts only objdump's printed ;0x... targets. The counts therefore describe those parsed annotations in the stated candidate spans, not a proof that every annotation is control flow or that all references were found.

Linear disassembly can interpret data as instructions and does not find alternate entries. Four .word rows remain unresolved; the branch annotation targeting 0x300440 does not resolve the semantics of the .word at that address.
Register-indirect transfers and non-control references are outside the direct-reference counts. The census excludes record 3, external ROM execution, runtime selection, and embedded-format discovery.

limits: This independently verifies pinned inputs, package record materializations, full objdump outputs, reproduction, and reported bounded counts.
It establishes no recursive control-flow completeness, code/data classification, canonical G1 admission, complete pseudocode, source completeness, or byte identity.
